original_goal:
[Module: Checkout - Overview | TC-006 | Type: Edge/Interaction | Priority: Medium]
Title: Browser Back after successful Finish does not allow duplicate order creation

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-step-two.html
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "user": "standard_user"
}

Preconditions:
  User is signed in; items are in cart; user has just successfully completed checkout via the Finish button

Steps to Execute:
  1. Click the **Finish** button on the Overview step
  2. Wait for the Confirmation page to be displayed
  3. Use the browser **Back** button once
  4. If the Overview page is shown, attempt to click **Finish** again

Expected Result:
  Re-submission is blocked; no second order is created; either the Finish button is disabled, a prevention message is shown, or the UI prevents submission; only one confirmation and order exist

Notes from prior verification:
  Manually verified for completion.
expected_outcome: Re-submission is blocked; no second order is created; either the Finish button is disabled, a prevention message is shown, or the UI prevents submission; only one confirmation and order exist
